## Projects

- homelab: Infrastructure as Code monorepo (Proxmox, Docker, Kubernetes) with Terraform and Ansible
- ckad-dojo: Kubernetes training platform for CKAD certification preparation
- good-points: Behavior tracking application for children
- cv_converter: Multi-format CV/resume generator
- hugo-site-manager: Hugo static site management CLI tool
- simplifalc: Text simplification tool (FALC - Facile a Lire et a Comprendre)
- leucocytes-tracking-app: Medical tracking application for leucocyte counts
- vagrant-k8s-cluster: Vagrant-based local Kubernetes cluster
- formation-python: Python training course materials
